projection.name: study
projection.columns: study_id, parent_study_id, unique_identifier, secondary_identifier, name, summary, date_planned_start, date_planned_end, date_created, date_updated, owner_id, update_id, type_id, status_id, principal_investigator, facility_name, facility_city, facility_state, facility_zip, facility_country, facility_recruitment_status, facility_contact_name, facility_contact_degree, facility_contact_phone, facility_contact_email, protocol_type, protocol_description, protocol_date_verification, phase, expected_total_enrollment, sponsor, collaborators, medline_identifier, url, url_description, conditions, keywords, eligibility, gender, age_max, age_min, healthy_volunteer_accepted, purpose, allocation, masking, control, assignment, endpoint, interventions, duration, selection, timing, official_title, results_reference, oc_oid, old_status_id, mail_notification, contact_email

query.name: findByPK
query.sql: SELECT @native(study) FROM STUDY WHERE STUDY_ID = ?

query.name: findByName
query.sql: SELECT @native(study) FROM STUDY WHERE NAME = ?

query.name: getStudyIdsByCRF
query.sql: select distinct study_id from event_definition_crf where crf_id=?

query.name: deleteTestOnly
query.sql: delete from study where name=?

query.name: findAll
query.sql: SELECT @native(study) FROM STUDY order by name

query.name: findAllByStudyId
query.sql: SELECT @native(study) FROM STUDY where (study_id =? or parent_study_id =?) and parent_study_id is not null order by name

query.name: findAllByStatus
query.sql: SELECT @native(study) FROM STUDY where status_id=?

query.name: findAllParents
query.sql: SELECT @native(study) FROM STUDY WHERE parent_study_id is null order by name

query.name: findAllByParent
query.sql: SELECT @native(study) FROM STUDY WHERE parent_study_id=? order by name

query.name: findAllByParentLimit5
query.sql: SELECT @native(study) FROM STUDY WHERE parent_study_id=? order by name limit 5

query.name: findAllByUser
query.sql: SELECT @native(study s) FROM study s, study_user_role sur WHERE sur.user_name = ? AND s.study_id=sur.study_id

query.name: findAllByUserNotRemoved
query.sql: SELECT @native(study s) FROM study s, study_user_role sur WHERE sur.user_name = ? AND s.study_id=sur.study_id AND sur.status_id != 5 AND sur.status_id != 7

query.name: findByOid
query.sql: SELECT @native(study s) FROM study s WHERE s.OC_OID = ?

query.name: findByUniqueIdentifier
query.sql: SELECT @native(study s) FROM study s WHERE s.unique_identifier = ?

query.name: findSiteByUniqueIdentifier
query.sql: select @native(study site) from study site, study study where site.parent_study_id = study.study_id and study.unique_identifier = ? and site.unique_identifier = ?

query.name: updateStepOne
query.sql: UPDATE STUDY SET PARENT_STUDY_ID=?, NAME=?, official_title=?, UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER=?, SECONDARY_IDENTIFIER=?, SUMMARY=?, PRINCIPAL_INVESTIGATOR=?, DATE_PLANNED_START=?, DATE_PLANNED_END=?, FACILITY_NAME=?, FACILITY_CITY=?, FACILITY_STATE=?, FACILITY_ZIP=?, FACILITY_COUNTRY=?, FACILITY_RECRUITMENT_STATUS=?, FACILITY_CONTACT_NAME=?, FACILITY_CONTACT_DEGREE=?, FACILITY_CONTACT_PHONE=?, FACILITY_CONTACT_EMAIL=?, STATUS_ID=?, UPDATE_ID=?, DATE_UPDATED=?, OLD_STATUS_ID=?, MAIL_NOTIFICATION=?, CONTACT_EMAIL=? WHERE STUDY_ID=?

query.name: findNextKey
query.sql: select nextval('study_study_id_seq') as key

query.name: createStepOne
query.sql: INSERT INTO STUDY (STUDY_ID, PARENT_STUDY_ID, NAME, official_title, UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER, SECONDARY_IDENTIFIER, SUMMARY, PRINCIPAL_INVESTIGATOR, DATE_PLANNED_START, DATE_PLANNED_END, FACILITY_NAME, FACILITY_CITY, FACILITY_STATE, FACILITY_ZIP, FACILITY_COUNTRY, FACILITY_RECRUITMENT_STATUS, FACILITY_CONTACT_NAME, FACILITY_CONTACT_DEGREE, FACILITY_CONTACT_PHONE, FACILITY_CONTACT_EMAIL, STATUS_ID, DATE_CREATED, OWNER_ID, OC_OID, MAIL_NOTIFICATION, CONTACT_EMAIL) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

query.name: createStepTwo
query.sql: UPDATE STUDY SET TYPE_ID=?, PROTOCOL_TYPE=?,PROTOCOL_DESCRIPTION=?, PROTOCOL_DATE_VERIFICATION=?, PHASE=?, EXPECTED_TOTAL_ENROLLMENT=?, SPONSOR=?, COLLABORATORS=?, MEDLINE_IDENTIFIER=?, results_reference=?, URL=?,URL_DESCRIPTION=?, CONDITIONS=?, KEYWORDS=?, ELIGIBILITY=?, GENDER=?, AGE_MAX=?, AGE_MIN=?, HEALTHY_VOLUNTEER_ACCEPTED=? WHERE STUDY_ID=?

query.name: createStepThree
query.sql: UPDATE STUDY SET PURPOSE=?, ALLOCATION=?, MASKING=?, CONTROL=?, ASSIGNMENT=?, ENDPOINT=?, INTERVENTIONS=? WHERE STUDY_ID=?

query.name: createStepFour
query.sql: UPDATE STUDY SET DURATION=?, SELECTION=?, TIMING=? WHERE STUDY_ID=?

query.name: updateSitesStatus
query.sql: UPDATE STUDY SET STATUS_ID=?, OLD_STATUS_ID=? WHERE PARENT_STUDY_ID=?

query.name: updateStudyStatus
query.sql: UPDATE STUDY SET STATUS_ID=?, OLD_STATUS_ID=? WHERE STUDY_ID=?

query.name: findAllSiteIdsByStudy
query.sql: SELECT study_id FROM study WHERE study_id = ? or parent_study_id = ?

query.name: findOlnySiteIdsByStudy
query.sql: SELECT study_id FROM study WHERE parent_study_id = ?

query.name: findByStudySubjectId
query.sql: select @native(study s) from study_subject ss, study s where ss.study_subject_id = ? and ss.study_id = s.study_id

query.name: findAllByParentStudyIdOrderedByIdAsc
query.sql: SELECT @native(study) FROM STUDY WHERE study_id=? or parent_study_id=? order by study_id asc
